name: Bk72Xx Ble Tracker → Stop Scan
description: Stop a running scan; also cancels a start that is still being retried, and switches the scanner to one-shot until a later `start_scan` restores the configured mode. Accepts the bare-id shorthand (`bk72xx_ble_tracker.stop_scan: my_tracker`) like `esp32_ble_tracker.stop_scan`.
